answer: Each new agent locks collateral behind an independently attested root, a hardware key or an already-bonded human, released after a cooldown. Keys are free to clone, so the gate is capital: a fake identity paying no delta in working capital earns nothing, and each clone needs its own frozen stake. A funding-graph pass traces identities sharing upstream transfers to one harbor of origin and slashes the linked set, so a cluster risks its whole pool, not one bond. Honest agents keep capital working; a spammer strands dead money and needs unrelated peers to vouch, so each new plume costs more.
